query: SELECT table_name, string_agg(column_name, ',' ORDER BY ordinal_position) AS columns FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name IN ('audit_log','bnk_accounts','bnk_applications','bnk_loans','bnk_members','bnk_transactions','calendar_events','collab_channels','companies','competitors','custom_kpis','finance_assets','finance_expenses','financial_benchmarks','hr_training','manufacturing_machines','manufacturing_maintenance','notification_channels','notification_rules','procurement_contracts','profiles','project_expenses','projects','sales_orders','scheduled_reports','support_tickets','workflow_marketplace_templates','workflows','workspaces') GROUP BY table_name ORDER BY table_name LIMIT 100;
